options.text: Both I and II are correct

questions.question: Which of the following animals can change their sex?
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which of the following can undergo Sublimation?
questions.solution:
• Ammonium chloride can undergo sublimation.
 
• Sublimation is the change in the state of a substance from solid directly to a gas without passing through the liquid phase.
 
• Sublimation is the decomposition of Ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) to form ammonia and hydrogen chloride gases.
 
• Ammonium chloride appears to sublime while heating, however, decomposes into ammonia and hydrogen chloride gas.

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 10 days and 15 days respectively. B starts the work and is joined by A after 5 days. If they earn a total of Rs. 60, what are their individual shares?
questions.solution:
A and B can complete a piece of work in 10 days and 15 days respectively,

Let total work be 60 units,

⇒ 1-day work of A = 6 units

⇒ 1-day work of B = 4 units

B starts the work and is joined by A after 5 days,

⇒ Work done by B in 5 days = 20 units,

⇒ Remaining work = 40 units which is done be A and B in the ratio of their efficiency

⇒ Work done by A = 24 units

⇒ Work done by B = 20 + 16 = 36 units

They earn a total of Rs. 60,

∴ Share of A = 24/60 × 60 = Rs. 24 and share of B = Rs. 36

Water to Squash ratio in first mixture = 4 : 1] × 4 = 16 : 4

questions.question: What is the principal focus of a spherical mirror?

options.text: It is a point from which the rays of light appear to be coming from on the principal axis of a convex mirror.
It is the point on the principal axis through which rays of light parallel to the principal axis pass after reflection or appear to be arising from this point on the principal axis.
It is the centre of a hollow sphere of which the spherical mirror is a part.
It is the midpoint of a spherical mirror.

questions.solution:
• The principal focus of a spherical mirror is that It is the point on the principal axis through which rays of light parallel to the principal axis pass after reflection or appear to be arising from this point on the principal axis.
 
• Generally, there are two types of spherical mirrors namely Convex Mirror and Concave Mirror.
 
• Convex mirrors are those whose reflecting surface is bent outwards and Concave Mirror are those whose reflecting surface is bent inwards.

 
 

 
 
**The principal focus of Concave Mirror**

 
 

 
 
 
A number of rays which drops parallel to the principal axis on a concave mirror converge at a point on the principal axis after getting reflected.

 
 
 

 
 
**The principal focus of Convex Mirror**

 
 
 
A number of rays which drops parallel to the principal axis after getting reflected, the rays emerge to come from a point on the principal axis.

 __

questions.question: Yaman sold an item at a loss of 10%. If he had sold it for Rs. 57 more, he would have made a profit of 20%. What should be the selling price of the item to make a profit of 30%?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the item be 100x.

Yaman sold an item at a loss of 10%,

⇒ Selling price = 90x

If he had sold it for Rs. 57 more, he would have made a profit of 20%,

⇒ New Selling price = 120x

⇒ 120x - 90x = 57

⇒ 30x = 57

⇒ Cost Price, 100x = Rs. 190

To make a profit of 30%,

∴ Selling price = 130/100 × 190 = Rs. 247

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 12?
questions.solution:
To check the divisibility by 12, we should check the divisibility by 4 and 3.

To check the divisibility by 3, the sum of digits of the number must be divisible by 3.

To check the divisibility by 4, the last two digits of the number must be divisible by 4.

The only number that is divisible by 3 is 53412 as the sum of its digit is 15 and divisible by 3.

**Alternate Method:**

Checking through options:

Option 1 : 53412/12 = 4526

Option 2 : 43412/12 = 3617.66…

Option 3 : 33412/12 = 2784.33…

Option 4 : 63412/12 = 5284.33…

∴ 53412 is divisible by 12.

K = 4 (1/2 mv²)

Therefore, Kinetic energy = 4K

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is sufficient to answer the question?

Find the values of x, y, z from the given statements.

**Statements:**

I: x + y = 12 : x + z = 4

II: x - y = 6

options.text: Only II is sufficient while I is not
Neither I nor II is sufficient
Both I and II are sufficient
Only I is sufficient while II is not

questions.solution:
**Statement I:**

x + y = 12 : x + z = 4,

Two equations and three variables, we cannot find the values of x, y and z.

Therefore, statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

**Statement II:**

x - y = 6

One equation and two variables, we cannot find the values of x, y and z.

Therefore, statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

From, both the Statements:

⇒ x + y = 12

⇒ x + z = 4

⇒ x - y = 6

As we have 3 equations and 3 variables, we can find the value of x, y and z.

∴ "**Both I and II are sufficient" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: A man lifts a luggage of 25 kg from the ground and puts it on the head, 2.5 m above the ground. If the value of g = 10 ms⁻², then the value of work done by him on the luggage is:
questions.solution:

• Given mass (m) of the luggage is 25 kg.

• Work Done (W) = m × g × h
 
• W= 25 × 10 × 2.5
 
• **W = 625 J (Therefore, Work done by man on the luggage is 625 J)**

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is true?

The velocity of sound is:

options.text: less in summer than in winter
more in summer than in winter

questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

Speed of a longitudinal wave in a medium:

__
 
• In a longitudinal wave, the particles of the medium oscillate forward and backward in the direction of propagation of the wave.
 
• They cause compressions and rarefactions of small volume elements of the medium.
 
• The velocity of sound is given by:

v = sqrt {frac{{γ P}}{rho }} 

where γ is constant for medium.

EXPLANATION__:

Effect of humidity

Rightarrow v = sqrt {frac{{gamma P}}{rho }} Rightarrow v propto (1)/({sqrt rho )}

 
• The **velocity of sound** **is more in summer** than in winter because the **sun evaporates more water from the surface** and as a result, the **moisture in the atmosphere is more** which makes the air travel faster. 
 
• Thus the humidity increases, the density of air decreases which increases the velocity of sound.

questions.question:
If a ball is thrown vertically upwards with a velocity of 40 m/s, then what will be the magnitude of its displacement after 6 s?

(Take g = 10 m/s²)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e __**60 m**__.

 
• Initial velocity (u) is given as 40 m/s.
 
• When a ball is thrown vertically upwards acceleration due to gravity is to be taken negative i.e a = - g = -10 m/s².
 
• Displacement of the ball from the ground (s)
 
• time taken (t) i.e 6 seconds.
 
• So by the formula s = ut + 1/2 at²
 
• s = ut - 0.5 × g × t² 
 
• = 40*6 - 0.5 × 10 × 36 
 
• = 240 - 180
 
• **= 60 m (displacement after 6 seconds from the starting point/ground)**
